# Muy Moderna

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store selling imported kitchen, organization, cleaning, car accessory, personal care, garden, tools, toys and pet items. Ships to all of Uruguay with a pickup point in Montevideo.
